suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as post traumatic disease sequela. Require a documented structural traumatic knee injury (for example ACL and/or meniscal injury) preceding separately documented post-traumatic knee osteoarthritis. Do not infer OA from nonspecific knee pain or strain alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Knee Instability / Meniscus Tear matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Post-Traumatic Arthritis with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Require a documented structural traumatic knee injury (for example ACL and/or meniscal injury) preceding separately documented post-traumatic knee osteoarthritis. Do not infer OA from nonspecific knee pain or strain alone.
